alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark lavender bedroom with a small clock that reads 3:12. A small amber block figure with white eyes sits up in bed, narrows its eyes, leans left and right and trembles as if arguing with someone, then its eyes go wide, it stretches tall with a chime, and finally smiles, victorious. At the end it looks at the camera with narrowed eyes. The text stays: me at 3 a.m. winning an argument from 2019.
